text.description_html:
Thumbturn Tailpiece for Tubular Entry Locksets

This is a replacement thumbturn tailpiece for the deadbolt of an Omnia Tubular Entry Locksets. It is 5 mm square on side that attaches to the thumbturn and flat where attaches to the deadbolt latch.

Features and Specifications of the Tailpiece for Omnia Entryset Deadbolt:

  • Total Length: 2-11/32" (60 mm)
  • Diameter: 3/16" (5 mm square)

Sold Individually
